Loved by teams building in production_

From fast-moving startups to global enterprises, developers ship faster with Appwrite.

Embedded security across every layer of the architecture_

With a security-first approach, Appwrite helps keep products and users safe by default, making it easier to adhere to strict safety policies.

DDoS protection

Automatically detect and mitigate distributed denial-of-service attacks.

Encryption

Built-in data encryption for sensitive workloads in rest and in transit.

Abuse protection

Protect your APIs from abuse with built-in platform safeguards.

Data migrations

Move data from third parties or between Cloud and self-hosted environments.

GDPR

Support data privacy workflows and safeguards for GDPR requirements.

SOC 2

Operate on infrastructure designed for high security and privacy standards.

HIPAA

Protect sensitive health data with security-first product controls.

CCPA

Build with controls that help protect sensitive user data.

The Appwrite Network_

Built into every Appwrite project: backend APIs, serverless functions, and hosted websites, with requests and assets served through our CDN and DDoS protection at the network edge. Choose global regions and edges to optimize latency, compliance, and data residency.
